final_assessment: Nine decisions, no open questions. The map links from the TEST side (a `@scenario` tag keyed by the capability/requirement/scenario title triple, measured unique over 1090 baseline scenarios), with a closed set of cover kinds (behaviour, text, observed, untestable) never summed; it is ENGINE-COMPUTED at `orbit status --change <name> --scenarios` and stored in no emit; every scenario in a change's ADDED/MODIFIED blocks owes a declaration, no baseline backfill. Four rules, each with a Mechanism entry (three DERIVED or SOURCED, zero open).
